cohort: Pregnant women who presented to the Firat University, Gynecology and Obstetrics Clinic with a diagnosis of premature rupture of membranes (PROM) between 24 weeks and 36+6 weeks gestation, and women who had an elective cesarean delivery between 37-41 weeks gestation.
finding: Amniotic fluid levels of IL-1beta, IFN-gamma, MIP-1beta and Fractalkine were significantly higher in the PROM group, while there was no difference in serum levels of those markers between the two groups.
gest_age: 24-36+6 weeks for the PROM group, 37-41 weeks for the control group
birth_weight: Significantly higher in the control group than in the PROM group
